reviews.text:
I had my cat examined here, and the service was very thorough and excellent. 🙏

I came because my cat's stool was quite smelly. Before coming here, I called another clinic for advice, and they suggested extensive tests like ultrasound and blood tests, costing around 30,000 yen, so I came to this hospital instead.

They started with a stool sample.

Also, my cat has a pre-existing condition, and they gave me thorough comments about that as well, which put my mind at ease.

The staff seemed to genuinely love animals, which made me feel very comfortable.
I use it all the time!
I'm glad it's located near Shibuya Station!
They are very kind to me.

My toy poodle's stool became loose, and although I waited to see how it would go, the diarrhea worsened, so I took him to the vet yesterday. The doctor listened carefully to my concerns about his appetite and stool condition, and prescribed necessary tests, IV fluids, and medication. After returning home, I let him rest, and by night he was feeling much better and the diarrhea had stopped. I was so worried that I couldn't sleep well, so I'm really glad I took him to the vet early.
I am grateful for the kind and attentive care of the doctor and nurses. I'm not currently in Shibuya, so it's a bit far, but I will continue to take my pet to Friends Animal Hospital whenever I'm worried about his health, as I can trust the doctor and nurses there.
Thank you very much.

The doctors and nurses are very kind.
Thank you as always.

I always have my dogs and cats examined here. The doctors and nurses are very kind and gentle, and when I reported my beloved dog's death on LINE, their kind words really encouraged me. I'll continue to rely on you in the future. Thank you very much ⁽˙ᵕ˙⁾

I've been using Friends since I got my dog. The nurses and doctors are all very kind and reassuring. When they trimmed, examined, or even neutered my dog, they told me about his condition while he was there, and I really feel that they are watching him closely...their gazes are filled with so much love. I feel at ease knowing that if anything happens, I can rely on Friends, and we (the two of us and my dog) can spend every day together!
